recycled_content.source_quote: The filament is created by reusing the recycled extrusion residual waste stream. The raw material is collected, shredded, re-mixed and homogenised into a high-grade and easy-to-print recycled PLA filament … As it is a fully recycled material, Spectrum rPLA may not be available
recycled_content.notes: Source calls it 'a fully recycled material' made from extrusion residual waste (manufacturing scrap) but gives no percentage, so pct is null.
